verdict.rationale: Docs describe automatic, continuous evidence collection from connected systems (Monitors checking AWS/Azure/GCP, integrations that 'automatically satisfy evidence requests', and platform copy stating data is 'collected automatically' and used for 'transparent continuous compliance monitors'), directly replacing manual screenshot/CSV gathering with machine-gathered artifacts tied to audits. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and explicit confirmation of timestamping metadata on individual artifacts.
